_note: Validator cases V1-V21 plus branch cases X1-X20. Each case gives a rule (wrapped as {name: '', rules: [rule]}) or a whole set, the expected error and warning codes, the path of the first issue (first error, else first warning), and the outcome of the rule set (engine): throws while the rules are loaded (every rule of the namespace stops), rejects-at-run (no rule fires for that event) or accepts; disabled rules are not loaded. stricter marks the cases the SDK rejects although the engine accepts them. Set-level cases load no rule at all (nothing fires).
